svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a flat pale oxide buries three thin purple pads, each capped by a thin hatched film and standing on a tungsten plug. After it a violet resist covers the oxide except for two narrow windows, one over the left pad and one over the right pad.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a flat pale oxide buries three thin purple pads, each capped by a thin hatched film and standing on a tungsten plug. After it a violet resist covers the oxide except for two narrow windows, one over the left pad and one over the right pad.
svg.text: Resist is coated, exposed through the contact reticle
and developed, opening the contact windows.
After: resist with two contact windows
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
